text:
alex: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can leadership clarify the shipping windows for three things we heard: API streaming/low-latency SLOs, the Console rollout for Optimize recommendations, and the public beta for quantization/packing suggestions? Need to plan Q3 sprint scope.

olivia (CEO): Short answer to set expectations: API streaming canary is targeted ~6 weeks out, Console Optimize UI beta ~9-10 weeks, and quantization recommendations beta nearer end-of-quarter. We'll surface owners and hard dates in the doc.

maria (Product): To add: 'canary' = internal + invite-only customers. API streaming will ship behind a feature flag initially. Public GA will be ~4 weeks after canary assuming no perf/regressions.

jon (Eng Lead): Re: API streaming runtime — one perf regression still being resolved. We plan two sprints to stabilize. Gating metric is p50 end-to-end token latency < 120ms on our synthetic workload. PR for perf tests: https://git.redwood/repo/streaming-perf (internal).

priya (Optimize Eng): For Optimize UI: recommendation engine backend is mostly ready; the blocker is UI + rollout guardrails. UX shipped mockups this morning. Release plan: staged beta -> power-user expansion -> org-wide.

dylan (PM): Action item: I'll own a single timeline doc that maps features -> canary date -> GA date -> owner. Tagging @maria @jon @priya to fill their pieces.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary-api-runtime -> 2027-08-15T14:00Z

alex: A couple quick product/ops nitpicks: 1) Will the rollout include automatic fallback to lower-capacity/quantized model variants if latency spikes? 2) Will Optimize suggestions be billable or free during beta?

maria (Product): 1) Yes — rollout policy includes automatic fallback to compatible quantized variants and non-streaming variants if we hit latency SLO breaches. 2) Optimize suggestions are free in beta; we'll revisit charging model post-beta (likely small per-eval charge).

jon (Eng Lead): Example feature flag for canary deploy:
```bash
export FEATURE_API_STREAM=true
./deploy canary
```

priya (Optimize Eng): We'll add an opt-in checkbox in Console for suggestion telemetry. Need legal/security sign-off on prompt telemetry. @lee (Security) can you weigh in?

lee (Security): We need to scope telemetry to hashed/aggregated metrics only. If product documents retention and opt-in, security can sign off. Please include retention window and access controls in the doc.

olivia (CEO): Thanks everyone. @dylan please produce the concise Q&A doc and we will publish dates in next week's product update. :thumbsup:

dylan (PM): Done — draft timeline doc: https://go.redwood/internal/roadmap/beta-windows (internal). I added owners, tentative dates, and the rollout guardrails checklist. Feedback welcome.

alex: Great — can marketing prep a short "what to expect" note for customers once dates are final? @sasha-marketing

sasha-marketing: Will draft a customer-facing blurb after dylan finalizes the doc. ETA 48h.

alex: Thanks all, that clears sprint planning. I'll sync with infra on quota changes after canary. :white_check_mark:
